name: smwmusic-b3313-sea-fort-ultramarine-stronghold
title: b3313 - Sea Fort / Ultramarine Stronghold
description:
A dinky remix of the SMB1 underwater music featured in b3313.

This port has instrumentation inspired by the SMAS version of the track, but don't be fooled, it still has all the poor MIDI conversion charm of the original, including the inaccurate notes and 4-note polyphony limit!
